author_pitch: I have seen dozens of academies lose thousands of dollars in refunds simply because their students get frustrated and drop out. title: AI Agent for Online Academies: Stop Dropouts and Multiply Your Educational Sales
body:
Are your students buying your course but never finishing it?

This is the biggest silent bottleneck in e-learning today. Online academies and B2C creators invest fortunes in acquisition, but suffer from dropout rates exceeding 70%. When a student gets stuck in a complex module at eleven at night, they get frustrated. Without immediate support, they close the tab, ask for a refund, or worse, never buy an advanced training course from you again. Your teaching staff's time is limited and cannot answer hundreds of technical questions instantly, stalling the growth of your educational business.

The trap of obsolete support forums

Most platforms rely on static forums or email support tickets that take days to be answered. This latency completely breaks the student's immersion and destroys the learning experience. A frustrated student today is a lost customer tomorrow.

Our solution: RAG AI Tutoring Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO we implement an Artificial Intelligence connected directly to your LMS (Moodle, LearnDash, or custom-built). We ingest all your videos, PDFs, and transcripts to create an Expert Virtual Tutor that perfectly masters your syllabus. This agent accompanies the student in real time, unblocking their progress without hallucinations.

  1. 24/7 hyper-contextual assistance: The AI Agent responds instantly based solely on your study materials, citing the exact lesson and minute of the video where the answer is found.
  2. Proactive anti-dropout intervention: We detect which students have been stuck in the same module for days, and the AI sends them a motivational message via WhatsApp or email with personalized hints.
  3. Real-time evaluation and feedback: It corrects practical exercises or essay exams instantly, offering constructive explanations so the student learns from their mistakes without waiting for a teacher.
  4. Educational up-selling engine: When the student successfully finishes a block, the AI automatically recommends the next masterclass or premium mentoring from your catalog based on their interests.

The Real Impact on your E-learning

  • Radical reduction in refunds: By eliminating friction and stagnation, completion rates skyrocket and returns due to dissatisfaction plummet.
  • Infinite teaching scalability: Multiply your enrollments tenfold without the need to hire an army of tutors or technical support assistants.
  • Increased Lifetime Value (LTV): A student who achieves real results thanks to the support of your AI is a loyal student, ready to invest in your High Ticket trainings.
